items: A rolling ground surface w x d. amp is the height of the roll, seed picks a different landscape, res is the number of cells per side.
A smooth mound: 2r across, h tall, flat where it meets the ground.
Ground rising to h across d. dir turns it on the plan (0 = climbs to the south/+Z, 90 = climbs to the east/+X).
A flat-topped terrace. w x d is the BASE; the top is inset batter x h on every side.
A battered wall holding a cut back: t thick at the top, t + batter x h at the base.
A ridge of earth with a triangular section — a noise bank, a dyke, a planted edge.
